components.css: .ds-faq{background:var(--surface,#20251f);color:var(--ink,#f3f5ec);border-radius:9px;font-family:'Chivo Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif}.ds-faq summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;list-style:none;padding:23px 25px;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;font-weight:450;line-height:1.5}.ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-faq summary:hover{color:var(--accent,#d8ec44)}.ds-faq summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#d8ec44);outline-offset:6px;}.ds-faq summary span{color:var(--accent,#d8ec44);font-size:24px;line-height:1;transition:transform 180ms ease}.ds-faq[open] summary span{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-faq p{color:var(--muted,#b9c1b3);font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;margin:0;padding:0 25px 25px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-faq summary span{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A quiet hi-fi editorial surface uses the app's charcoal and acid-yellow identity, substantial type, and a phone-to-PC listening illustration. These are autonomous, code-led decisions documented after implementation, not an approved visual comp.

This system applies to the Astro landing page in `website/`. It does not prescribe changes to the native WPF application's controls, layout, or theme. Ground truth is `website/src/styles/global.css`, the Magic UI styles and components, and the rendered structure in `website/src/pages/index.astro`.
keyCharacteristics: Green-tinted charcoal surfaces with one acid-yellow accent.
Locally bundled Chivo typography and generous sectional spacing.
Flat surfaces with responsive product illustrations.
Motion restricted to the audio demonstration, button interaction, and desktop entrance.

rules.name: The contrast rule
rules.body: Use deep-green text on the acid-yellow surface and retain the dark focus outline on the final download button.

dos: Do retain the locally bundled Chivo family and the extracted palette roles.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and the reduced-motion behavior.
Do label the product illustration as a preview with no device connection.
Do keep the mobile download action visible as layouts simplify.
donts: Don't apply this web layout system to native WPF views without a separate design task.
Don't use decorative player controls as misleading interactive buttons.
Don't introduce card shadows where the current system uses tonal separation.
Don't treat small illustration labels as reusable body or control typography.
